text:
Our wedding is on 12 September at the Gasthof Zur Linde in Hallein, and I want the budget sorted before the next payment falls due. So far we have booked the hall and catering deposit for 4,200 euros, the photographer for 1,150 euros and the flowers for 640 euros. The band is still undecided; Rosina Klammer quoted 900 euros, but we haven't confirmed, and her price includes the sound equipment only if we book before July.

My fiancé Dominik Aichhorn and I agreed that his father, Siegfried Aichhorn, will contribute 5,000 euros as a gift, but only after the photographer is paid in full. He has not said yet when he can transfer it. My own parents are not contributing anything.

We still owe the photographer 575 euros, due by 30 June, and the hall wants its second instalment of 2,100 euros by 15 July. I get paid on the 28th, so anything due before then has to come from our joint account. It currently holds 1,900 euros.
task: Make a dated list of the vendor payments we still owe so I can check them against my payday.

text: We're trying to cap the wedding on 20 June at 11,000 euros. So far the florist, Blumen Mühlbauer, has quoted 1,380 euros, and Cakery Lindner wants 420 euros for a three-tier cake, which rises by 60 euros if they deliver it. My partner Jana Eder was laid off from the bakery in January and starts at her new job only in April, so she has no income until then. I'm a bricklayer on a steady salary and can put aside 900 euros a month, and my partner will add 500 euros a month from May. Jana's brother Benedikt has promised to drive the guests from the church, which saves the 350 euro shuttle, as long as the date stays on a weekend. The venue deposit of 1,800 euros is already paid and should not be counted again.

The Weinstube Hofer in Graz has confirmed the back room for Friday 20 November, seating for 28 and a set menu at 48 euros per head, drinks extra. Dinner starts at 6:30 pm. They need the final headcount by Monday, and a fixed 400 euro deposit goes with it. If fewer than 20 people come, a room charge of 250 euros applies instead of the menu minimum.

I'm hosting, but I have to watch the clock. My ex-husband, Reinhard Zechner, collects our two children from my flat every Friday at 8 pm under the custody arrangement, and I won't change that, so someone else would have to host after I leave.

The guest of honour is Brigitte Wolf, who retires after 31 years at the savings bank branch. Her colleague Lukas Moser is collecting 10 euros from everybody for the gift and will hand it over after dessert. Toasts are planned for after the main course.

Hi Katharina, here is where the hen weekend stands. The cabin in the Zillertal is 620 euros for two nights, the activities (rafting and a spa half-day) are 340 euros, and the food shop is about 220 euros, so the total is 1,180 euros for eight of us, which is 147.50 each if we split it equally.

Sabine Hollerer told me she can only manage 80 euros in total because she has been on reduced hours since January. She was signed off with burnout last year and would rather nobody else knows.

I can pay the cabin deposit of 300 euros today, and the rest has to be there by 1 May. Tell me if you want rafting cancelled, because the operator needs a final yes by 20 April. Nobody should be pressured to pay more than they said.
